# Noble Desktop

> > Noble Desktop offers design, coding, and career training courses with certificate programs in web development, data science, and creative skills.

Noble Desktop is a tech education platform providing hands-on training in web development, programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Ruby on Rails), design disciplines (UX/graphic design), and professional tools (AutoCAD, Excel, WordPress). The school combines bootcamp-style coding programs with design courses and offers industry-recognized certificates for career advancement.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- Web Development
- Certificate Programs
- UX Design
- Graphic Design
- SQL
- HTML & CSS
- Ruby on Rails
- Data Science
- Career Training
- WordPress
- MySQL
- AutoCAD
- Tech Education
